paragraph: Most agencies don't show you the engine. We lead with it. Every client gets a custom-built MarTech stack — dashboards, automation, attribution, and AI — all wired together.

orm.brief: BrandThink's ORM CMS Platform helps businesses monitor, analyze, and manage their online reputation through a unified AI-powered system. The platform combines social listening, sentiment analysis, automated reporting, real-time alerts, and intelligent workflows to help brands respond faster and make data-driven reputation decisions.
